scope: Client developer isolated VM/state/contract checks, not real UI/HTTP/model or independent QA

tests.name: Frozen 30-unit/240-point/114-question package validates every exact evidence and child target
One root access allows Q1 only, not whole-chapter Q9/Q20; tertiary goes only to explicit parent; navigation remains navigation
Real question detail and exact source crosslinks, personal evidence boundary and missing ID
Question mark stored once, synchronized knowledge and records, known/cancel/weak cycle
Only eligible visited-point questions sampled; requested shortage explicit; self-report outcomes preserve chosen wrong marking
Settings font/start preference persists; settings helper hidden; public historical values unchanged
Export preserves all earlier original bytes, current notes/projects and self marks separately
Corrupt curriculum quote/source package fails explicitly without fake question fallback
Async pending can collapse/navigate; completion does not reopen or steal current context
Review moves one question at a time; known leaves weak list and still-weak remains after session ends
Delayed earlier response cannot overwrite later submission or recommendation history
